<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--onesimus">Onesimus extension</span>

Read, create, change, delete configuration resources as raw text (Onesimus).

## Synopsis

```text
.config capabilities [json]
.config list [json] type=<type>
.config read [json] type=<type> name=<name>
.config create [json] type=<type> text64=<text64> [validate_only]
.config update [json] type=<type> name=<name> sha256=<sha256> text64=<text64>
               [validate_only]
.config delete [json] type=<type> name=<name> sha256=<sha256> [validate_only]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Reads, creates, changes and deletes configuration resources as raw text (the same logic as the DirectorApi configuration RPCs). Changes need the CommandACL configure and the SHA-256 of the text read.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `json` | keyword |  |  |  | Print the JSON object as text. |

These arguments apply to every subcommand as well.

## Subcommands

### .config capabilities {#sub-config-capabilities}

**Editable types and operations.**

Shows the interface version and, per resource type, the operations the configuration CRUD offers (READ\_RAW, CREATE\_RAW, UPDATE\_RAW, DELETE). The editable types are schedule, job, jobdefs and client. Without the CommandACL configure no types are listed.

```text
.config capabilities [json]
```

Also accepts the arguments of [.config](#arguments): `json`.

The editable types and their operations:

```text
.config capabilities
```

### .config list {#sub-config-list}

**Resources of a type.**

Lists the resources of one type (schedule, job, jobdefs or client) with their file, SHA-256 and whether the file holds more than one resource. Resources the console may not see by its resource ACL are left out.

```text
.config list [json] type=<type>
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type=` | enum | `client`, `job`, `jobdefs`, `schedule`, `fileset` |  | required | Resource type. |

Also accepts the arguments of [.config](#arguments): `json`.

All client resources with file and checksum:

```text
.config list type=client
```

### .config read {#sub-config-read}

**Raw text of a resource.**

Returns the raw text of one resource byte for byte, with its file and SHA-256. The checksum is the optimistic lock for a later update or delete. A resource the console may not see gives the status DENIED.

```text
.config read [json] type=<type> name=<name>
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type=` | enum | `client`, `job`, `jobdefs`, `schedule`, `fileset` |  | required | Resource type. |
| `name=` | string |  |  | required | Resource name. |

Also accepts the arguments of [.config](#arguments): `json`.

The raw client text and its checksum:

```text
.config read type=client name=bareos-fd
```

### .config create {#sub-config-create}

**New resource from text.**

Creates a resource from its raw text, given base64 encoded in text64= because a console line carries no line ends. The new configuration is checked like odir -t, written atomically and reloaded, with rollback if the reload fails. With validate\_only the text is only checked, nothing is written.

A result status other than OK (EXISTS, INVALID, DENIED ...) is reported in the response, not as a command error. Needs the CommandACL configure.

```text
.config create [json] type=<type> text64=<text64> [validate_only]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type=` | enum | `client`, `job`, `jobdefs`, `schedule`, `fileset` |  | required | Resource type. |
| `text64=` | string |  |  | required | Resource text, base64. |
| `validate_only` | keyword |  |  |  | Check only, write nothing. |

Also accepts the arguments of [.config](#arguments): `json`.

Check a new schedule without writing it:

```text
.config create type=schedule text64=U2NoZWR1bGUgewogIE5hbWUgPSBOaWdodGx5CiAgUnVuID0gRnVsbCBzdW4gYXQgMjM6MDAKfQo validate_only
```

### .config update {#sub-config-update}

**Replace a resource.**

Replaces the raw text of a resource. sha256= must be the checksum from the last read; if the file changed since, the status is CONFLICT and nothing is written. The text is checked like odir -t, written atomically and reloaded with rollback; validate\_only only checks. Needs the CommandACL configure.

```text
.config update [json] type=<type> name=<name> sha256=<sha256> text64=<text64>
               [validate_only]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type=` | enum | `client`, `job`, `jobdefs`, `schedule`, `fileset` |  | required | Resource type. |
| `name=` | string |  |  | required | Resource name. |
| `sha256=` | string |  |  | required | SHA-256 of the text read. |
| `text64=` | string |  |  | required | Resource text, base64. |
| `validate_only` | keyword |  |  |  | Check only, write nothing. |

Also accepts the arguments of [.config](#arguments): `json`.

Replace a schedule with new text:

```text
.config update type=schedule name=Nightly sha256=5b1e9a3c text64=U2NoZWR1bGUgewogIE5hbWUgPSBOaWdodGx5CiAgUnVuID0gRnVsbCBzYXQgYXQgMjI6MDAKfQo
```

### .config delete {#sub-config-delete}

**Delete a resource.**

Deletes a resource, guarded by the checksum from the last read. If other resources still refer to it the status is REFERENCED, the referring resources are listed and nothing is deleted. validate\_only only checks. Needs the CommandACL configure.

```text
.config delete [json] type=<type> name=<name> sha256=<sha256> [validate_only]
```

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type=` | enum | `client`, `job`, `jobdefs`, `schedule`, `fileset` |  | required | Resource type. |
| `name=` | string |  |  | required | Resource name. |
| `sha256=` | string |  |  | required | SHA-256 of the text read. |
| `validate_only` | keyword |  |  |  | Check only, write nothing. |

Also accepts the arguments of [.config](#arguments): `json`.

Check whether a client could be deleted:

```text
.config delete type=client name=old-fd sha256=5b1e9a3c validate_only
```

## Examples

The job resources as one JSON line:

```text
.config list type=job json
```

The raw text of a schedule with its checksum:

```text
.config read type=schedule name=WeeklyCycle
```
